name: tx_regform2
x87_stkflt_note: R2-H06: this program drives the x87 stack past its ends. QEMU implements no stack faults, so the differential masks fstat IE|SF|C1|C0|C2|C3 (0x4741 -- the #IS response has no QEMU counterpart; C1 is the direction bit and C0/C2/C3 are implementation-defined per SDM Vol.1 Table 8-4) and the st* QNaN-indefinite substitution. The behavior itself is gated architecturally by px87stk.
x87_stkflt_ranges_note: The mask is the EXACT measured divergence set of an unmasked compare vs the pinned-QEMU golden (20 records, n=0..19): the FSTPL m64 at n=14 underflows the emptied stack (fstat IE|SF on the faulting record only; the m64 destination is not a compared field and no st* diverges). The FNINIT/FLD1/FSTP resync at n=15..17 clears the sticky IE|SF on both sides, so records n=15..19 compare with ZERO masks. st0..st7 compare at full strength on EVERY record (no fpr mask at all).
